title: Precision in Every Frame: Volker Schlöndorff wins Silver Peacock for Best Director for ‘Visitation’ at IFFI 2026
subtitle: Jury celebrates the director’s masterful orchestration of performances, editing and music
body_text:
Posted On: 28 NOV 2026 8:54PM by PIB Mumbai Release ID: 2343244 Views: 68 A A Print Share X Facebook Instagram WhatsApp Copy Article Link
Read in: English Urdu Marathi हिन्दी
Goa, 28 November 2026 German filmmaker Volker Schlöndorff has been awarded the Silver Peacock for Best Director for his film ‘Visitation’ in the Main International Competition at the 57th International Film Festival of India (IFFI). The award was presented by Dr. Pramod Sawant, the Chief Minister of Goa, in the presence of Shri Chanchal Kumar, Secretary, Ministry of Information & Broadcasting; and Festival Director Shri Ashutosh Gowariker. Representing Schlöndorff at the closing ceremony were Axel Schneppat, the film’s Director of Photography, and Konrad Waldmann from the cinematography team, who accepted the Silver Peacock on his behalf. In bringing a narrative spanning generations to the screen, Schlöndorff demonstrates a remarkable command over the cinematic medium. The jury recognised the director’s ability to weave together the artistic and technical elements of filmmaking into a cohesive cinematic experience, marked by precision and restraint. “ This film impressed us with its precision employed in every detail, be it in the performance of the assembly of actors, in the flawless editing and powerful yet subtle musical score,” the jury observed. A veteran of German cinema, Volker Schlöndorff brings decades of filmmaking experience to ‘Visitation’ . Having studied economics and political science, he honed his craft in Paris under renowned filmmakers Louis Malle, Jean-Pierre Melville and Alain Resnais. He co-founded the production company Bioskop in 1973 and has also directed operas in Frankfurt, Berlin and Paris. The Silver Peacock for Best Director recognises exceptional directorial vision and the filmmaker’s contribution in bringing a cinematic work to life in the Main International Competition. The award carries a Silver Peacock trophy, a certificate and a cash prize of ₹20 lakh. Synopsis of ‘Visitation’ (Heimsuchung) : Set in a lakeside house near Berlin, ‘Visitation’ traces a century of German history through the lives of its successive inhabitants. From the rise of Nazism and the devastation of the Second World War to Soviet rule and German reunification, the house bears silent witness to profound historical transformations. A Jewish family, an architect and his wife, a writer and her granddaughter inhabit the property across different generations, each grappling with the uncertainties of their times. Adapted from Jenny Erpenbeck’s novel of the same name, the film explores themes of home, belonging, displacement and memory against the backdrop of a changing nation. IFFI 2026: Best Director
